e.title: Monitora TISS（巴西）：强制上报数据的质量监测程序与 TISS×DIOPS 完整度比对
e.title_en: Monitora TISS (Brazil): a data-quality monitoring programme for mandated reporting, with a TISS-vs-DIOPS completeness comparison
e.title_hk: Monitora TISS（巴西）：強制上報數據的質量監測程序與 TISS×DIOPS 完整度比對
e.summary: ANS 对强制 TISS 上报数据设立的质量监测程序：以「答疑值班」答疑、按主题归类常见问题，并做 TISS 与 DIOPS 会计口径之间的完整度比对
e.summary_en: A data-quality monitoring programme the ANS runs over mandated TISS reporting: question-and-answer sessions, FAQs grouped by theme, and a completeness comparison between TISS and the DIOPS accounting source
e.summary_hk: ANS 對強制 TISS 上報數據設立的質量監測程序：以「答疑值班」答疑、按主題歸類常見問題，並做 TISS 與 DIOPS 會計口徑之間的完整度比對
e.body:
**Monitora TISS** 是 **ANS（巴西补充医疗监管局）** 针对 **[[ans-tiss-standard]]** 上报数据设立的**质量监测程序**。本条目是上一则条目的配套，补的是**「监管者如何治理被强制上报数据的质量」这一形态**——**「有标准」不等于「数据能用」**，而池内此前**有数据质量工具、没有监管侧的数据质量治理机制**（对比：[[acord-data-quality-monitor]] 是**行业组织 ACORD 的提交数据质量监控工具**、[[eiopa-monthly-rfr-check]] 是**单点数据校验脚本**、[[great-expectations]] 是**通用数据质量框架**——**三者都不是「监管者对全体被监管机构上报数据的治理程序」**）。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：⭐ **页面 273.1KB，标题实测「Monitora TISS」**；正文实测写明 **「O Monitora TISS é o programa de monitoramento da qualidade dos dados do Padrão TISS」**（**Monitora TISS 是 TISS 标准的数据质量监测程序**）；⭐ 实测写明 **「A realização de Plantões de Dúvidas se constitui em uma ação do monitoramento do Padrão TISS, a fim de prestar orientações necessárias ao aprimoramento da qualidade dos dados informados」**——**以「答疑值班（Plantões de Dúvidas）」作为监测手段，目的是提升所报数据质量**；⭐ 实测写明 **「As perguntas sobre o Padrão e a completude TISS X DIOPS encontram-se detalhadas a seguir e estão divididas de acordo com o tema」**——**围绕标准本身以及 TISS 与 DIOPS 之间的「完整度（completude）」比对，问题按主题分类列出**；实测可见的问答分组包括 **「VERSÃO 4 / NOVA VERSÃO DO PADRÃO」** 等；**页面更新日期实测 21/11/2025 16h42**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「监管侧数据治理」这一形态**——池内数据质量条目**全在工具层**（见上），而 **Monitora TISS 是「监管者发布标准 → 全行业被迫上报 → 监管者反过来监测上报质量」的闭环**；对做**监管科技与数据治理**方向的学生，**这是比工具更上层的一种机制**（可与 [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]、[[apra-insurance-statistics]]、[[hk-ia-statistics]]、[[ivass]] 的监管统计口径并读——**那些是监管者「发布统计」，这一条是监管者「治理上游数据」**）。**② 「TISS × DIOPS 完整度比对」是一个可直接迁移的方法论**——**同一批业务，用两条不同口径的上报数据互相校验完整度**；对做**数据质量评估**的学生，这是一个**具体的、有官方定义的对账思路**（可与 [[lossratio-r]]、[[health-insurance-reserving-handbook]]、[[databricks-medicare-risk-adjustment]] 并读）。**③ 「答疑值班」这一做法本身值得注意**——**监管者把「答疑问」制度化为质量改进手段**，而不是单纯罚款；这对研究**监管执行风格差异**的学生是一个具体观察点。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**页面存在、标题、三处关键正文表述、问答分组标签与更新日期**，**但未展开阅读任何一条问答内容**，因此**不能转述 TISS 与 DIOPS 完整度比对的**具体指标定义、阈值或判定规则**；**② DIOPS 是什么、其与 TISS 的字段对应关系本次未单独核实**——**「DIOPS」仅作为页面正文中出现的术语被引用**，本词条不展开其定义；**③ 「Plantões de Dúvidas」的实际举办频率、参与情况与效果未核实**；**④ 本词条不主张该程序公布具体机构的合规排名或评分**（**这一点未核实，故不主张**）；**⑤ 页面以葡萄牙语为主**。**核实说明**：页面（273.1KB，标题「Monitora TISS」）HTTP 200 实测，三处正文表述逐字读取，更新日期 21/11/2025 16h42；**未展开任何问答条目、未单独核实 DIOPS 定义**。
e.body_en:
**Monitora TISS** is the **data-quality monitoring programme** the **ANS** (Brazil’s supplementary-health regulator) runs over reporting under **[[ans-tiss-standard]]**. This entry accompanies the previous one and adds the **"how a regulator governs the quality of mandated reporting"** form — **a standard does not by itself make data usable** — the corpus previously had **data-quality tools but no regulator-side data-quality governance mechanism** (compare [[acord-data-quality-monitor]], an **industry body’s submission-quality monitor**; [[eiopa-monthly-rfr-check]], a **single-point validation script**; and [[great-expectations]], a **general-purpose data-quality framework** — **none of the three is a regulator’s programme for governing reporting across all supervised firms**).

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): ⭐ the **page is 273.1KB with the measured title "Monitora TISS"**; its body states verbatim that **"O Monitora TISS é o programa de monitoramento da qualidade dos dados do Padrão TISS"** (**Monitora TISS is the data-quality monitoring programme of the TISS standard**); ⭐ it states verbatim that **"A realização de Plantões de Dúvidas se constitui em uma ação do monitoramento do Padrão TISS, a fim de prestar orientações necessárias ao aprimoramento da qualidade dos dados informados"** — **question-and-answer duty sessions serve as a monitoring action aimed at improving the quality of reported data**; ⭐ it states verbatim that **"As perguntas sobre o Padrão e a completude TISS X DIOPS encontram-se detalhadas a seguir e estão divididas de acordo com o tema"** — **questions about the standard and about the "completeness" comparison between TISS and DIOPS are set out below, grouped by theme**; measured question groups include **"VERSÃO 4 / NOVA VERSÃO DO PADRÃO"**; the **measured last-updated date is 21/11/2025 16h42**.

For RIAA: **① it adds the "regulator-side data governance" form** — the corpus’s data-quality entries are **all at the tool level** (see above), whereas **Monitora TISS closes the loop of "regulator issues a standard → the whole industry must report → the regulator then monitors the quality of what it receives"**; for students working on **regtech and data governance**, this is **a mechanism one layer above the tools** (readable with the regulatory-statistics entries [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]], [[apra-insurance-statistics]], [[hk-ia-statistics]] and [[ivass]] — **those publish statistics; this one governs the upstream data**). **② The "TISS vs DIOPS completeness" comparison is a directly transferable methodology** — **the same business, reported through two different channels, cross-checked for completeness**; for **data-quality assessment** work this is **a concrete, officially defined reconciliation approach** (readable with [[lossratio-r]], [[health-insurance-reserving-handbook]] and [[databricks-medicare-risk-adjustment]]). **③ The "question-and-answer duty session" practice is itself notable** — **the regulator institutionalises answering questions as a quality-improvement instrument** rather than relying on penalties alone, a concrete observation point for students studying **differences in supervisory enforcement style**.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **page existence, the title, three verbatim body statements, question-group labels and the update date**, **but read no individual question-and-answer item**, so **the specific indicator definitions, thresholds or decision rules of the TISS-DIOPS completeness comparison cannot be restated**; **② what DIOPS is, and how its fields map to TISS, was not separately verified** — **"DIOPS" is cited only as a term appearing in the page text, and this entry does not expand its definition**; **③ the actual frequency, participation and effect of the "Plantões de Dúvidas" sessions were not verified**; **④ this entry does not claim the programme publishes per-firm compliance rankings or scores** (**unverified, therefore not claimed**); **⑤ the page is mainly in Portuguese**. **Verification note**: the page (273.1KB, title "Monitora TISS") was measured at HTTP 200, three body statements were read verbatim, and the update date is 21/11/2025 16h42; **no question item was expanded and the DIOPS definition was not separately verified**.
e.body_hk:
**Monitora TISS** 是 **ANS（巴西補充醫療監管局）** 針對 **[[ans-tiss-standard]]** 上報數據設立的**質量監測程序**。本條目是上一則的配套，補的是**「監管者如何治理被強制上報數據的質量」這一形態**——**「有標準」不等於「數據能用」**，池內此前**有數據質量工具、沒有監管側的數據質量治理機制**（對比：[[acord-data-quality-monitor]] 是**行業組織的提交數據質量監控工具**、[[eiopa-monthly-rfr-check]] 是**單點校驗腳本**、[[great-expectations]] 是**通用數據質量框架**——**三者都不是「監管者對全體被監管機構上報數據的治理程序」**）。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：⭐ **頁面 273.1KB，標題實測「Monitora TISS」**；正文寫明 **「O Monitora TISS é o programa de monitoramento da qualidade dos dados do Padrão TISS」**；⭐ 寫明 **「A realização de Plantões de Dúvidas se constitui em uma ação do monitoramento do Padrão TISS, a fim de prestar orientações necessárias ao aprimoramento da qualidade dos dados informados」**——**以「答疑值班」作為監測手段以提升上報數據質量**；⭐ 寫明 **「As perguntas sobre o Padrão e a completude TISS X DIOPS encontram-se detalhadas a seguir e estão divididas de acordo com o tema」**——**圍繞標準本身以及 TISS 與 DIOPS 之間的「完整度」比對，問題按主題分類**；實測可見分組含 **「VERSÃO 4 / NOVA VERSÃO DO PADRÃO」**；**更新日期實測 21/11/2025 16h42**。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「監管側數據治理」這一形態**——池內數據質量條目**全在工具層**，而 **Monitora TISS 是「監管者發標準 → 全行業上報 → 監管者反過來監測上報質量」的閉環**；對做**監管科技與數據治理**的學生，**這是比工具更上層的機制**（可與 [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]、[[apra-insurance-statistics]]、[[hk-ia-statistics]]、[[ivass]] 並讀——**那些是監管者「發布統計」，這一條是監管者「治理上游數據」**）。**② 「TISS × DIOPS 完整度比對」是可遷移的方法論**——**同一批業務、兩條口徑互相校驗完整度**；**③ 「答疑值班」這做法本身值得注意**——**監管者把「答疑問」制度化為質量改進手段**，而非單純罰款，對研究**監管執行風格差異**是一個具體觀察點。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**頁面存在、標題、三處關鍵正文表述、問答分組標籤與更新日期**，**但未展開閱讀任何一條問答內容**，故**不能轉述完整度比對的具體指標定義、閾值或判定規則**；**② DIOPS 是什麼、其與 TISS 的欄位對應關係本次未單獨核實**——**「DIOPS」僅作為頁面正文中出現的術語被引用**；**③ 「Plantões de Dúvidas」的實際頻率、參與情況與效果未核實**；**④ 本詞條不主張該程序公布具體機構的合規排名或評分**（**未核實，故不主張**）；**⑤ 頁面以葡萄牙語為主**。**核實說明**：頁面（273.1KB）HTTP 200 實測，三處正文逐字讀取，更新日期 21/11/2025 16h42；**未展開任何問答條目、未單獨核實 DIOPS 定義**。
e.verified_note: HTTP 200 实测（页面 273.1KB 标题「Monitora TISS」；正文逐字含「O Monitora TISS é o programa de monitoramento da qualidade dos dados do Padrão TISS」「A realização de Plantões de Dúvidas se constitui em uma ação do monitoramento do Padrão TISS…」「As perguntas sobre o Padrão e a completude TISS X DIOPS encontram-se detalhadas a seguir e estão divididas de acordo com o tema」；问答分组实测含「VERSÃO 4 / NOVA VERSÃO DO PADRÃO」；更新日期 21/11/2025 16h42）+ ★池内数据质量条目全在工具层（acord-data-quality-monitor / eiopa-monthly-rfr-check / great-expectations），监管侧数据质量治理机制 0；未展开任何问答条目、未单独核实 DIOPS 定义、未核实答疑值班实际频率
